name: Emergency dispatch
summary: Accept the call, navigate, attach evidence and close it from the phone.

name: SOS feed
summary: Citizen panic and officer SOS in one live feed, routed to the nearest unit.

name: T-Safe
summary: Citizens share a journey; a route deviation raises an emergency incident.

name: Hawk Eye
summary: A two-way thread with the citizen, with live officer ETA. Anonymous reports allowed.

name: e-Complaint
summary: The complainant speaks in their own language; the text is transcribed, translated and classified.

name: Records search
summary: One federated search across crime records, court linkage and bureau records.

name: Facial recognition
summary: Face match with a liveness check. A match is a lead only and needs supervisor sign-off.

details.label: How it works
details.text: The officer points the phone, the platform extracts the biometric template, searches the gallery and returns a ranked candidate.

details.label: Safeguard
details.text: An investigative lead only. The officer verifies against the record and a supervisor signs off before any action. Every scan, result and sign-off is logged.

name: Digital evidence
summary: Geotagged, hashed evidence with chain of custody and a statutory certificate.

name: Mobile / tower data
summary: Requests need a case link and two levels of senior approval before any data comes back.

name: OSINT
summary: Flags misinformation and upcoming public events from open sources.

name: Hotspots
summary: Crime forecast in 250 m cells, with time windows and patrol tasking.

name: MO offenders
summary: Find offenders by how they operate: snatching, house break, two-wheeler theft.

name: Release alerts
summary: Alert when a repeat offender is released into the officer's jurisdiction.

name: Point book
summary: Geofenced beat check-ins, with points graded by risk each shift.

name: CCTV grid
summary: Beat cameras with plate-read alerts and AI video analytics.

name: Traffic
summary: Quick e-challan with photo evidence, synced to the enforcement system; the owner gets an SMS.

name: Cyber fraud freeze
summary: Bank freeze requested within the golden hour after a fraud complaint.

name: HRMS
summary: Duty roster, leave, payslips, e-files and the officer fitness score.
